description: Angular component for configuring deduplication rules in a rule node, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: DeduplicationConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for managing deduplication configuration form.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the deduplication configuration form group.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the input configuration, setting default outMsgType if missing.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables the outMsgType control based on the selected strategy.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns the list of form controls that trigger validation updates.
